Duplexes and backyard units could go in more Dallas neighborhoods, under a draft of new city rules released November 5.

Dallas released the first draft of its new development code on Thursday, November 5. It's more than 400 pages, and it's the first full rewrite of the city's zoning rules since the 1980s.

The draft would allow duplexes in the proposed R1 and R2 home districts, with design standards so they fit the scale of the street.
